Making the appointment and completing registration were both so easy, the office is SO clean and inviting, and everyone on staff was so incredibly kind to Penny and me. Brooke, the receptionist, kept friendly conversation with us until we were called into an exam room and created such a positive environment in the waiting room. Sanaa was the technician who took the BEST care of Penny and even let her bring a blanket from home in the back to make the process less scary, and she was so great at explaining everything so there was no confusion. We also had Dr. Phillips taking care of our girl, and she was so friendly, accommodating, and confident about what she was prescribing! Overall, Penny was treated with nothing but quick and gentle care, and I will 100% come back in the future! If you're trying to find a new vet, THIS is your sign!!

I have been bringing my dog to this clinic for the past 4–5 years. During that time, my pet has maintained a consistent history of annual examinations and has even undergone surgery for a genetic condition that was diagnosed and treated through this practice. As a result, the clinic has extensive medical records and familiarity with my dog's health needs.

Unfortunately, my dog requires a prescription diet that can only be obtained through a veterinarian. Despite my dog having completed an annual exam just seven months ago, I am now being told that another annual examination is required simply to renew a food prescription because the clinic has changed veterinarians yet again. This is the third or fourth veterinarian change I have experienced at this location over the last several years, which raises concerns about the consistency of care and staff retention.

Three weeks ago, I requested a refill for my dog's prescription food and was informed by Wendy that it would be processed. However, I received no follow-up communication regarding any issues with the request. Today, I had to contact the clinic myself to check on the status, only to learn that the prescription would not be filled. While Wendy was able to contact me regarding another pet's vaccination needs, no one reached out regarding the food prescription request.

What is most frustrating is being asked to pay for another annual examination solely to obtain a prescription food renewal when the clinic has years of medical history on file and my dog was examined less than a year ago. As a long-term client, I would expect better communication, continuity of care, and a more reasonable process for handling prescription diet renewals.

I also requested a callback from both a veterinarian and the office manager to discuss these concerns. Unfortunately, no one was able to provide a timeframe for when I could expect a response.

I am extremely disappointed with the lack of communication, the repeated turnover of veterinarians, and the burden being placed on established clients as a result. I hope management will address these concerns and improve both communication and continuity of care moving forward.
